operations.name: Register source and branch plan
operations.action: Register the reviewed final article and technical supplement by hash, inspect full coverage, and freeze source facts separately from authored control requirements.
operations.precondition: Complete written source coverage; inspect every unresolved input
operations.completion_evidence: Source-qualified review only; physical route stays on HOLD_QUALIFICATION
operations.on_failure: Keep accepted holder and lease; record failed/uncertain evidence; request qualified containment through future approved external service; reconcile status without blind retry.

operations.name: Resolve prospective repeat and decision plan
operations.action: Review a prospectively approved branch plan. Keep repeat count, thresholds, durations and condition values null until external qualification; reject frame count as n.
operations.precondition: Qualified plan for branch conditions, repeat units, exclusions and acceptance
operations.completion_evidence: Plan ID and independently approved scope
operations.guard: Missing count, dwell or threshold is not auto-filled
operations.on_failure: Keep accepted holder and lease; record failed/uncertain evidence; request qualified containment through future approved external service; reconcile status without blind retry.

operations.name: Accept design-specific protected specimens
operations.action: Bind a unique specimen to its own M1/M2/M3 family, fabrication batch and supported carrier. Review release, material safety and groove condition. No fabrication or direct handling is performed.
operations.precondition: Fabrication and handling receipts from S03
operations.guard: Reject/hold mismatched identity or blocked grooves
operations.on_failure: Keep accepted holder and lease; record failed/uncertain evidence; request qualified containment through future approved external service; reconcile status without blind retry.

operations.name: Accept current array characterization
operations.action: Review individual transducer identities, selected/rejected membership, current aggregate characterization and assigned branch. Replacements or drift invalidate downstream evidence.
operations.precondition: Individual member and aggregate array records
operations.guard: Drift or replacement invalidates dependent calibration
operations.on_failure: Keep accepted holder and lease; record failed/uncertain evidence; request qualified containment through future approved external service; reconcile status without blind retry.

operations.name: Accept supported station custody
operations.action: Review safe access and supported handoff to the closed metrology service; keep old custody until receiver acceptance and require exclusive current resource leases.
operations.precondition: Safe access and qualified support before transfer
operations.completion_evidence: Accepted mounted custody and exclusive lease
operations.on_failure: Keep accepted holder and lease; record failed/uncertain evidence; request qualified containment through future approved external service; reconcile status without blind retry.

operations.name: Validate optical and torsion transformations
operations.action: Review separate pixel, screen, pendulum, specimen-displacement and optional force transformations with uncertainty, signs and units. Do not infer the effective lever from rod length.
operations.precondition: Reference calibration, sign check, clock mapping and uncertainty
operations.completion_evidence: Current calibration epoch linked to specimen and array
operations.guard: No conversion from spot motion alone
operations.on_failure: Keep accepted holder and lease; record failed/uncertain evidence; request qualified containment through future approved external service; reconcile status without blind retry.

operations.name: Admit one branch attempt
operations.action: Admit a finite synthetic attempt only after all branch dependencies resolve. A request creates no physical service action; uncertain external admission must be reconciled before any future retry.
operations.precondition: Branch-specific dependencies resolved; current qualified service plan
operations.completion_evidence: Unique trial/attempt ID; actual capture readiness
operations.guard: No blind retry after uncertain admission
operations.on_failure: Keep accepted holder and lease; record failed/uncertain evidence; request qualified containment through future approved external service; reconcile status without blind retry.

operations.name: Collect branch service evidence
operations.action: Review returned raw records from closed equipment services. Keep source command separate from observed emission and source-position readback; require matching clocks, identities and epochs.
operations.precondition: Qualified services retain control over powered operation
operations.completion_evidence: Raw camera/source-state/pose/time records with result status
operations.guard: Requests, program schedules and plot samples are not execution receipts
operations.on_failure: Keep accepted holder and lease; record failed/uncertain evidence; request qualified containment through future approved external service; reconcile status without blind retry.

operations.name: Review baseline and control pairing
operations.action: Review baseline and controls without deleting raw observations or failed attempts. Derived quantities retain every transform and raw parent. Source outcomes are never evaluator pass constants.
operations.precondition: Raw records, plan and valid calibration
operations.guard: Keep lost tracking, drift and nonresponses
operations.on_failure: Keep accepted holder and lease; record failed/uncertain evidence; request qualified containment through future approved external service; reconcile status without blind retry.

operations.name: Determine continuation or remount need
operations.action: Require observed terminal attempt status before continuation. Any flip, remount, array revision, optics movement, clock break or support fault re-enters affected acceptance and calibration gates.
operations.precondition: Observed attempt terminal state and scientific sufficiency review
operations.completion_evidence: Continue same qualified lease, or route through safe hold before change
operations.guard: Changing mount/array requires new acceptance and requalification
operations.on_failure: Keep accepted holder and lease; record failed/uncertain evidence; request qualified containment through future approved external service; reconcile status without blind retry.

operations.name: Review remaining numerical source arms
operations.action: Record stress-tensor/prism, analytical/optimized groove, coiled topology and beam-width branches as numerical/theoretical source reviews only. No solver, mesh, field or physical-data comparison is run.
operations.completion_evidence: Typed review-only records for every theoretical/numerical extension
operations.on_failure: Keep accepted holder and lease; record failed/uncertain evidence; request qualified containment through future approved external service; reconcile status without blind retry.

operations.name: Establish independent safe closeout
operations.action: Require independently observed current acoustic-off, beam-safe, motion-safe and support-safe records that cover the actual configuration. A request, timeout or disabled control is insufficient.
operations.precondition: Authoritative observed source-off, beam-safe, motion-safe, support-safe evidence
operations.completion_evidence: Safe-to-access release covering the actual configuration
operations.guard: Stop/disable requests and timeouts do not prove safety
operations.on_failure: Keep accepted holder and lease; record failed/uncertain evidence; request qualified containment through future approved external service; reconcile status without blind retry.

operations.name: Complete supported return or quarantine
operations.action: Review supported return or accepted quarantine and from/to holder chain. Never release an unsupported suspended specimen, infer custody from location, or perform automatic cleaning/disposal.
operations.precondition: Current access release and documented support
operations.completion_evidence: Receiver acceptance, condition and known final occupancy
operations.guard: Uncertain specimen location blocks normal completion
operations.on_failure: Keep accepted holder and lease; record failed/uncertain evidence; request qualified containment through future approved external service; reconcile status without blind retry.

operations.name: Seal review or experiment evidence state
operations.action: Seal an evidence archive distinguishing complete synthetic bookkeeping, unresolved scientific holds and actual execution. Every admitted specimen and attempt remains accounted for; branch end is not session end.
operations.precondition: All branch attempts, exclusions and custody closures accounted
operations.completion_evidence: Read-only archive with unresolved science and failures retained
operations.guard: A review never increments completed conversions
operations.on_failure: Keep accepted holder and lease; record failed/uncertain evidence; request qualified containment through future approved external service; reconcile status without blind retry.

operation_id_semantics: R01–R14 are reusable symbolic operation definitions, not one-shot physical script instructions. Per-branch instance order is defined by dependencies and observed receipts.
